description: The HR-91 RTO serves the Gharaunda sub-division in the Karnal district of Haryana. This office operates under the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) and is responsible for vehicle registration, licensing, and traffic regulation enforcement for the region along the National Highway 44.
address: Office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM), Gharaunda, District Karnal, Haryana
